points.description: Complete, mathematically valid solution (discriminant (u-v)^2-16 must be a perfect square, so |u-v|=4 or 5; count 26+25=51 unordered pairs out of C(30,2)=435) with final answer 17/145 (equivalently 51/435). Any wrong step or wrong final answer earns 0.

rubric.notes: Full mark only for a fully valid solution reaching 17/145. Any invalid step or wrong final answer gets 0. Equivalent methods and wording are accepted.
rubric.answer_key: Roots of x^2+(u+v)x+uv+4 have discriminant (u-v)^2-16. Need it to be a perfect square k^2, so (d-k)(d+k)=16 with d=|u-v|; same-parity factor pairs give d=5 (2·8) or d=4 (4·4). Parity then works out so roots are integers. Unordered pairs with difference 4: 26; difference 5: 25; total 51. Total pairs C(30,2)=435. Probability = 51/435 = 17/145.
